title: Surgical ShortFlows: Dry-Run Validator and Telemetry Suggester
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a lightweight framework for authoring and validating ultra-small operator runbooks ("shortflows") as first-class tasks: implement a local dry-run validator, a sequencing emulator for replay fidelity, and a telemetry-driven suggestion engine that proposes missing safety checks or required rollbacks before runbook execution. The goal is to reduce manual incident remediation time by giving on-call engineers safe, reviewable micro-actions that can be linted, previewed, and executed with guarded permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Authors can create a shortflow YAML and run `shortflow validate` locally; validator returns deterministic lint/errors.
Sequencing emulator can replay a shortflow against a synthetic cluster snapshot and surface divergent state transitions in under 30s for common flows.
Telemetry suggester surfaces at least three safety recommendations (eg. check branches, idempotency tokens, circuit-breakers) for 80% of existing runbook corpus during analysis.
Integration tests exercise guarded execution path with policy-enforced RBAC and produce an audit log entry for every dry-run and live-run.
Public API for the validator available as a non-breaking CLI subcommand and as a small HTTP endpoint for Console integration.
steps: Design task schema for shortflows (inputs, asserts, compensations, idempotency markers).
Prototype local dry-run validator (node/python binary) that performs static checks and basic sequencing emulation.
Build lightweight sequence emulator to simulate state transitions using fixture snapshots and mock cell responses.
Hook telemetry suggester: static + telemetry-derived heuristics to recommend missing safety steps.
Add CLI commands: shortflow init, shortflow validate, shortflow emulate, shortflow publish.
Create integration tests and e2e test harness with sample synthetic incidents.
Instrument audit + Console UI surface to preview suggested fixes and dry-run diffs.
Ship initial opt-in flag and gather usage/false-positive metrics for two weeks.
Iterate on heuristics; prepare runbook remediation patterns for common infra categories.
Document rollout plan and runbook authoring guide in Confluence.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False-positive suggestions may reduce trust in the suggester — Mitigation: ship with opt-in mode and telemetry to measure precision.
Risk: Emulation diverges from prod for external eventual-consistency operations — Mitigation: add 'quiesce' and 'observability checkpoints' that map to real traces.
Risk: RBAC surface for executing shortflows could be abused — Mitigation: require policy-provided scopes and an audit hook; deny by default for high-risk actions.
Risk: CI runtime blowup when emulating large runbooks — Mitigation: cap depth, sample transitions, and add a lightweight 'fast-lint' path for quick developer feedback.
